entities.description: A brown canvas backpack with a soft, slouchy structure is worn on the back of a person, featuring a front pocket with a flap and drawstring closure. The backpack has wide, padded brown straps with black plastic buckles, and the material appears to be a durable, slightly wrinkled fabric.

A wooden bench with a rustic, natural finish is shown, featuring visible wood grain and knots. Two people are seated on the bench, one wearing distressed blue jeans with large rips at the knees, and the other wearing beige or khaki pants. The bench has sturdy, thick legs and a simple, functional design.

clothing.pants: distressed blue jeans with large rips at the knees

entities.description: An elderly man with white hair and a mustache sits on a wooden bench, wearing a brown tweed flat cap, a brown wool vest over a light grey button-down shirt, and khaki pants. He holds a wooden walking cane with a T-shaped handle between his legs and smiles warmly while looking to his left.

entities.description: A young woman with long, wavy brown hair sits on a wooden bench, wearing a mustard yellow knit sweater and distressed blue jeans with large rips at the knees. She holds a stack of four hardcover books in her lap and has a brown backpack strap over her shoulder, smiling gently while looking off to the side.
